description: Led React.js to Next.js migration across 30–40 routes — adopted App Router, refactored to server components, and rebuilt the data-fetching layer for SSR, lifting Lighthouse Performance from ~40 to 75+.
Integrated Razorpay as primary payment gateway with Paytm and CCAvenue fallbacks — built webhook handling, retry logic, and failover on the backend, reducing payment drop-off from 9% to 4%.

Built Continue Purchase Logic and rebuilt PDP, PLP, and Checkout flows end-to-end, driving a 9× web conversion lift (1.16% → 11.3%) and implemented SEO architecture supporting 71% organic traffic growth.
briefing.impact: The Next.js migration, payment overhaul, and conversion-focused engineering directly delivered a 9× web conversion lift and 71% organic traffic growth for a 1M+ user edtech platform.

description: Replaced the Chrome new-tab page with a unified Kanban board — built end-to-end on Manifest V3 architecture with a real-time sync layer pulling from Jira, GitHub, Asana, and Linear simultaneously.
Implemented OAuth 2.0 flows for all four integrations, handling token storage, refresh cycles, and permission scoping within the extension sandbox.
Shipped and published to the Chrome Web Store, where it remains live and installable.
briefing.impact: A single extension that turns every new tab into a live project dashboard — built solo from architecture to store listing, syncing four issue trackers in real time.

description: Built an agentic system that ingests a GitHub PR URL, performs structured code review using an LLM, and posts inline comments via the GitHub REST API — designed end-to-end.
Designed the prompt orchestration and tool-calling pipeline using LangChain and Mastra AI, structuring the agent's reasoning steps and output format for actionable review comments.
Implemented GitHub API integration for PR diff ingestion, comment threading, and review submission — handling authentication, rate limits, and diff parsing.
briefing.impact: An agent that reads a PR, reasons about the code, and writes inline review comments — replacing a manual review step with a structured, repeatable AI pipeline.

description: Architected and built the platform backend in Python and Flask — designed the data model, REST API, and service-scheduling logic end-to-end for a security services business.
Implemented authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), and data encryption for sensitive user and service workflows — covering the full security surface from auth to storage.
Owned the full lifecycle from API design through deployment, building service-management and scheduling features that form the operational core of the platform.
briefing.impact: Designed and shipped a purpose-built security-services platform backend — RBAC, encryption, scheduling, and REST API — built solo from data model to deployment.

description: Money Hive — Flutter finance app with a multi-wallet data model, on-device AI categorization, CSV/PDF export, and in-app purchase billing. Swallow Organics — Flutter Shopify storefront with full checkout via the Shopify Storefront API.
Both apps shipped cross-platform to iOS and Android via Google Play; additional published apps include Dr. Maths and The Maze.
Owned client, API, and data layers across all apps — from architecture and state management through store submission.
briefing.impact: Multiple cross-platform Flutter apps shipped to Google Play — finance, commerce, education, and games — built end-to-end across client, API, and data layers.

description: Architected a game boosting service platform on WordPress with WooCommerce for order management.
Deployed on Google Cloud for scalable, low-latency delivery to a global gaming audience.
Implemented advanced security measures, cutting data breaches by 50% and boosting user trust.
briefing.impact: Migrating to Google Cloud infrastructure improved uptime and reduced latency for international users, directly increasing order conversion and operational efficiency by 30%.

description: Built the Aegis AV Cabinets website on WordPress using the Divi theme and its visual builder.
Designed pixel-perfect layouts and product showcase pages with Divi's drag-and-drop interface.
Implemented quality-focused content structure, elevating product reliability perception by 20%.
briefing.impact: The Divi-powered visual builder enabled rapid iteration on design without developer bottlenecks, cutting manufacturing product page turnaround time by 15% and improving customer satisfaction.
